Video2Player — test fixture

Primary video (2.35:1, with subtitle track)

Letterboxed on a phone screen, so pinch-to-zoom has real black bars to crop. Burned-in timecode makes seeking accuracy visible.

Decoy video (too small to take over)

Detection must ignore this one and pick the primary video above.

Same-origin iframe player

Exercises the all_frames content script path.

Multiple sources (quality switching)

Two <source> elements, so the quality menu has something real to switch between.
